description: Build the complete React frontend with Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and all components/hooks. Frontend lives at d:\Pranjal Bandi\Crop-Disease-D-P-main\frontend\. Uses VITE_API_URL from frontend/.env.local. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 (both can be built in any order since they share only the API contract).
steps: 1. Scaffold the Vite + React project inside frontend/: run `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react` (or manually create package.json, vite.config.js, index.html). Install deps: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, framer-motion, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, lucide-react, axios, @deepgram/sdk. Initialize Tailwind: npx tailwindcss init -p. Do NOT overwrite frontend/.env.local.

2. Configure Tailwind (frontend/tailwind.config.js): content paths ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,jsx}'], extend theme with custom colors — accent: {purple: '#8b5cf6', violet: '#a78bfa', deep: '#7c3aed'}, background: {dark: '#0a0a0f', card: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'}.

3. Create frontend/src/index.css with Tailwind directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities) plus global styles: body background #0a0a0f, scrollbar styling, glassmorphism utility class (.glass { @apply bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl }), CSS gradient mesh background with animated purple ambient blobs using @keyframes.
4. Create frontend/src/main.jsx: render App inside BrowserRouter + StrictMode.

5. Create frontend/src/App.jsx: Routes — '/' renders HomePage, '/analysis' renders AnalysisPage. Wrap in AnimatePresence for page transitions. Include Navbar at top, ambient background div with gradient mesh blobs.
6. Create frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx: Fixed top glass bar. Left: 'PlantAI' logo text with purple gradient. Right: minimal nav links or just a GitHub icon. Framer Motion fade-in on mount.

7. Create frontend/src/pages/HomePage.jsx: Centered hero section. Large heading 'AI Plant Disease Detective' with gradient text. Subtitle 'Upload or capture a leaf image to detect plant diseases'. Two glass cards side by side (stacked on mobile): (a) Upload card — drag & drop zone with dashed border, click to browse, accepts image/*, shows lucide Upload icon, animated gradient border on hover/drag. (b) Camera card — lucide Camera icon, button to capture, uses <input type='file' accept='image/*' capture='environment'>. On image selected, store in state and navigate to /analysis with image data (use React Router state or a context/store). Framer Motion: cards stagger in with spring animation, scale bounce on drag over upload zone.

8. Create frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.jsx: Two-column layout on desktop (grid-cols-2), single column on mobile. Left column: uploaded image with rounded-2xl, purple glow border (box-shadow), Framer Motion fade-in. Right column: stacked cards — DiseaseCard, WeatherCard, TreatmentPanel. Below both columns: VoiceChat section. On mount: call /predict with the image, call /weather with location coords, then call /chat for initial AI analysis. Use loading skeletons while waiting. Framer Motion staggered card entrance.

9. Create frontend/src/components/DiseaseCard.jsx: Glass card. Disease name in large text. Confidence shown as an animated circular progress ring (SVG circle with stroke-dashoffset animated via Framer Motion) or a horizontal bar. Color: green if is_healthy, red/orange if diseased. Framer Motion: number counts up to confidence value.

10. Create frontend/src/components/WeatherCard.jsx: Glass card. Shows city name, temperature (large), humidity, weather description, wind speed, weather icon (from OpenWeatherMap icon URL). Graceful fallback: if location denied, show 'Location unavailable — weather data requires location access' message. Lucide icons for temp/humidity/wind.

11. Create frontend/src/components/TreatmentPanel.jsx: Glass card. Shows AI analysis text (causes, treatment, weather impact). Renders markdown-like content (bold, bullet points). Skeleton loader (pulsing glass bars) while loading.

12. Create frontend/src/components/VoiceChat.jsx: Contains the Orb, transcript area, and text input fallback. Transcript area: scrollable div, user messages right-aligned with purple bg bubble, AI messages left-aligned with glass bubble. Text input: glass input bar with send button (lucide Send icon). Orb component centered between transcript and input. Status text below orb: 'Tap to speak' / 'Listening...' / 'AI is speaking...' based on voice state. Clicking the orb toggles listening.

13. Create frontend/src/components/Orb.jsx: The animated voice orb — a div with rounded-full, sized ~24-32 (w-24 h-24 to w-32 h-32). Use Framer Motion animate prop with different variants per state: idle (subtle scale pulse 1.0→1.05, purple glow shadow, slow loop), listening (larger scale 1.1→1.2, ripple rings via pseudo-elements or additional motion.divs expanding outward with opacity fade, color shift to brighter violet/cyan via background gradient), speaking (organic morph — animate borderRadius between blob-like values like '60% 40% 30% 70% / 60% 30% 70% 40%', scale wobble, warm purple/pink gradient, faster animation). Use CSS background: radial-gradient or linear-gradient with animated hue. Glow via box-shadow with animated spread.

14. Create frontend/src/hooks/useApi.js: Axios instance with baseURL from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL. Export functions: predictDisease(imageFile) — POST /predict with FormData, getWeather(lat, lon) — GET /weather, sendChat(message, disease, weather, history) — POST /chat, getDeepgramToken() — GET /deepgram-token, getTTS(text) — POST /tts with responseType 'arraybuffer'.

15. Create frontend/src/hooks/useLocation.js: Custom hook wrapping navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition. Returns { lat, lon, error, loading }. On mount, requests position. On error, sets error string. Handles permission denied gracefully.

16. Create frontend/src/hooks/useVoice.js: Manages voice conversation state machine (idle/listening/processing/speaking). On startListening: fetch token from /deepgram-token, open WebSocket to Deepgram STT (wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen), get microphone via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}), create MediaRecorder, send audio chunks to WS. On final transcript from Deepgram (is_final: true), stop recording, set state to processing, call sendChat, then call getTTS with the reply, play audio via AudioContext/new Audio(blob URL), set state to speaking while playing, back to idle on audio end. Expose: state, transcript, startListening, stopListening, messages array.
17. Create frontend/src/components/SkeletonLoader.jsx: Reusable skeleton component — animated pulsing glass bars of configurable height/width for loading states.
18. Update frontend/vite.config.js to set server port to 5173 (default) and proxy /api to backend if desired (optional — direct CORS is configured).
19. Create frontend/index.html with proper meta tags, dark theme meta color, title 'PlantAI — Disease Detection', and root div.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in frontend/ completes with zero errors
All component files exist and are syntactically valid JSX
Tailwind config includes custom theme colors
All hooks (useApi, useLocation, useVoice) are properly exported
Routing works: / shows HomePage, /analysis shows AnalysisPage
Orb has three visual states (idle, listening, speaking) with Framer Motion animations
Dark purple glassmorphism theme is applied globally
No API keys are hardcoded in frontend code
findings: Build verified with vite v6.4.4 — 2012 modules transformed, zero errors. dist/ output: index.html (0.63KB), CSS (16.77KB), JS bundle (377KB gzip 126KB). esbuild required install-scripts approval on npm v11. npm run build returns exit code -1 due to npm v11 shell behavior on Windows but npx vite build exits 0 cleanly. All 19 steps implemented: Vite+React scaffold, Tailwind with custom purple theme, glassmorphism globals, routing with AnimatePresence, Navbar, HomePage with drag-drop+camera, AnalysisPage with 2-col layout, DiseaseCard with SVG progress ring, WeatherCard with graceful fallback, TreatmentPanel with markdown rendering, VoiceChat with text fallback, Orb with 3 Framer Motion states (idle/listening/speaking), SkeletonLoader, useApi (all 5 endpoints via VITE_API_URL), useLocation, useVoice (Deepgram STT WebSocket + TTS playback). No API keys in frontend code.
